Bill.BriefDescription: Appointing regional directors at the department of fish and wildlife.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the appointment of regional directors at thedepartment of fish and wildlife; and amending RCW 77.04.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.04.080 and 2000 c 107 s 205 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) Persons eligible for appointment as director shall havepractical knowledge of the habits and distribution of fish andwildlife. The director shall supervise the administration andoperation of the department and perform the duties prescribed by lawand delegated by the commission. The director shall carry out thebasic goals and objectives prescribed under RCW 77.04.055. Thedirector may, consistent with this section, appoint and employnecessary personnel. The director may delegate, in writing, todepartment personnel the duties and powers necessary for efficientoperation and administration of the department. (b) Only persons having general knowledge of the fisheries andwildlife resources and of the commercial and recreational fishingindustry in this state are eligible for appointment as director. The p. 1 HB 3144director shall not have a financial interest in the fishing industry ora directly related industry. The director shall receive the salaryfixed by the governor under RCW 43.03.040. (c) The director is the ex officio secretary of the commission andshall attend its meetings and keep a record of its business. (2)(a) Prior to appointing or employing an individual as theregional director of a departmental suboffice, the department'sdirector must ensure that the candidate is fully vetted with the localcommunity. (b) Full local vetting may only be assured if the regional directorcandidate has met with, or at least shown a good faith attempt to meetwith, the following prior to the candidate's appointment: (i) Each member of the state house of representatives whoselegislative district includes geographic areas included in theapplicable departmental region; (ii) Each member of the state senate whose legislative districtincludes geographic areas included in the applicable departmentalregion; and (iii) Each member of the county legislative authorities for everycounty included in the applicable departmental region's geographicarea. (c) If any one of the county legislative authorities votes, as abody, in the majority to express nonconfidence in the regional directorcandidate prior to the candidate's permanent appointment, thedepartment director must suspend that person's candidacy. Once aperson has his or her candidacy suspended under this section, he or shemay not be reconsidered for a regional director position for anygeographic area that contains the county or counties expressingnonconfidence for a period of thirtysix months. (d) This subsection applies to permanent appointments. A personmay serve as an interim regional director for up to three months priorto satisfying the requirements of this section.
